integrity.claim_basis: Explicit null-cone harmonic moment argument and exact-arithmetic finite cross-checks.

limitations: Only the equal-radius sign cube and restriction of one exact harmonic degree are treated.
The result characterizes ranks and missing characters, not all nonzero singular values.
Equivalent closed rank formulas in unindexed older literature remain a residual originality risk.
title: Two exceptional Walsh obstructions in exact-degree harmonic interpolation on the hypercube
